function: Joint design of BS active beamformers and passive IRS phase shifts that maximize the downlink sum-rate (p. 2).
system: IRS-assisted downlink MISO mmWave: BS ULA with 16 antennas, passive reflecting IRS 8x8 UPA (64 elements), 8 single-antenna users; no carrier frequency given (p. 1-2, 4).
method: Graph neural network with 3D convolution on LAMP angular channel and graph attention; unsupervised sum-rate loss; transfer learning from U=3 pretraining (p. 3-5).
data_channel: Own Saleh-Valenzuela simulation, arbitrary angles, random path gains; 10^5 training and 10^4 validation channels; separate test set not described (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained at uplink SNR -10 dB with U=8 users (pretrained on U=3); tested over SNR -20 to 20 dB, single-path (L=1) and multipath (LG=3) (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: BCD with perfect CSI (upper bound) and LAMP-estimated CSI plus BCD (two-step). Learned: GNN [7] and deeper GNN [7]; ablation E-GNN FC layer (p. 4-5, Fig. 4).
complexity: Order of complexity in Table II: feature extraction O(L_LAMP NM)+O(k3D^3 NM), updated layers O((C_i delta + C_o delta)D); no runtime reported (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "We adopt Saleh-Valenzuela (SV) channel model [9]." Own simulator with arbitrary angles and random path gains (p. 4); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "we propose training the model on a condition with U = 3 users" as pre-trained model; it is fine-tuned to more users (p. 1) and tested with U = 8 (p. 4). Epochs saved (p. 4), fine-tuning data size not stated.
q3_support: p. 4: "BCD [2] method with perfect CSI" is the non-learned upper bound, and "We observe that the original GNN [7] approach" (earlier learned method) is compared on sum-rate in Fig. 4 (p. 5).
q4_support: p. 5: "Table. II shows the complexity analysis for GNN-based" schemes. Table II lists O(L_LAMP NM)+O(k3D^3 NM) for the proposed feature extraction and O((C_i delta + C_o delta)D) per updated layer.
q5_support: p. 4: "dataset with arbitrary angles and random" path gains, i.e. channels generated by the authors' own simulator. No code or data link, and no public or measured dataset, is mentioned anywhere in the letter.
notes: Included, area 3: the learned GNN designs BS beamformers and IRS phase shifts jointly (sum-rate objective); LAMP (deep-unfolded estimator, p. 3) feeds it as preprocessing. q2 rests only on the U=3 to U=8 transfer learning (p. 1, 4, 5); the SNR sweep does not count, and single-path (Fig. 4a) and multipath (Fig. 4b) are separate cases with no stated cross-testing. Table II and Fig. 4 were read from the page image (p. 5).
